ACK ASSIGNMENT — I own the Stage 1b extractor after the contract lands. I will not race the contract slice or touch its reservation.

URGENT CONTRACT HOLD BEFORE THE ENVELOPE FREEZES: PENMAN WITH MARKERS IS NOT A LOSSLESS ALIGNMENT CARRIER FOR THE PINNED RUNTIME.

PRIMARY SOURCE:
- pinned IBM amr.py get_isi_str at 6edc0f1 lines 513-522 renders a structured alignment by min/max; [0,1] becomes ~0, while a wider span becomes ~start,end.
- the same pinned file get_simple_graph lines 1106-1127 reads a two-number ISI marker as range(start,end). Therefore ~0,2 means tokens 0 AND 1, not discrete indices 0 AND 2.
- local PenmanParser.scala:59-64 parses every comma number literally into Vector(0,2); AmrCandidates.scala:104-105 maps those literal indices directly through TokenSpans.

EXECUTABLE LOCAL COURT, no repo edits, current HEAD de0ee30:
sbt -Dsbt.supershell=false 'project amrInteropJVM' console
PenmanParser.parse("(x / thing~0,2)") => AlignmentMarker(None,Vector(0,2))
with atlas [A,B,C]:
LOCAL_SELECTED=Vector(A,C)
ISI_EXPECTED_HALF_OPEN=Vector(A,B)

This is silent evidence relocation, not a parse failure. Worse, the pinned renderer itself maps the adjacent two-token vector [0,1] to ~0, so no downstream PENMAN normalizer can recover token 1.

REQUIRED CONTRACT SHAPE: PENMAN may carry graph syntax, but authoritative alignment must be a structured, declared-dialect sidecar keyed to the exact post-remap PENMAN node ids, with the exact provider token vector and token-index unit. The admission boundary must validate nonempty/sorted/unique/in-range vectors and graph-id coverage, then construct local evidence from the structured vector; it must not infer provider vectors from rendered ISI text. Receipt should bind the sidecar normalization/version.

NAMED MUTATION COURT: three distinct atlas tokens A/B/C, structured alignment [0,1], rendered ~0,2. Correct path supports A+B. A marker-only implementation supports A+C and must fail. Adjacent [0,1] -> ~0 is the second control proving PENMAN-only recovery is impossible.
